articles.summary: HOUSTON, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Moleculin Biotech, Inc. (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”) today announced that it will present at the upcoming 2026 Maxim Growth Summit in New York, NY. Details of the presentation are as follows: Session: Advances in Oncology PanelPresenter: Walter Klemp, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Moleculin Date/time: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, from 9:00 – 10:00 a.m. ETLocation: NYY Room at the Hard Rock Hotel NYC Mr. Klemp will discuss Moleculin’s oncology pipeline and recent clinical progress, including the Company’s lead investigational candidate, Annamycin, and its ongoing Phase 2/3 MIRACLE clinical trial evaluating Annamycin in combination with cytarabine (AnnAraC) for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML). Moleculin recently announced that Part A enrollment is completed in the MIRACLE trial, and the Company remains on track for its planned comprehensive data readout of Part A in the first quarter of 2027. In addition to the Company’s presentation, management will be available for meetings with institutional investors in one-on-one sessions. This prestigious event brings together industry leaders, innovators, and premier institutions to explore the latest trends and advancements across several industries. articles.summary: Access the Moleculin CEO Corner here HOUSTON, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Moleculin Biotech, Inc. (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”) today announced that it has released the next segment on its CEO Corner, a platform featuring Walter Klemp, Chief Executive Officer. In this episode of CEO Corner, Moleculin Biotech Chairman and CEO Walter Klemp discusses the progress of the Company’s Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial evaluating Annamycin in combination with high-dose cytarabine (HiDAC) for patients with second-line relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). The discussion highlights the completion of enrollment in Part A, encouraging interim efficacy results, Annamycin’s potential to address treatment resistance and cardiac safety concerns associated with conventional anthracyclines, and the anticipated full 90-patient Part A data readout in the first quarter of 2027. Mr. Klemp also outlines the next steps toward the pivotal Part B expansion and the broader potential for Annamycin across AML and other cancers treated with anthracyclines. Access the CEO Corner on the Company’s website here. About Moleculin Biotech, Inc. Moleculin Biotech, Inc. is a Phase 3 clinical stage pharmaceutical company advancing a pipeline of therapeutic candidates addressing hard-to-treat tumors and viruses. articles.summary: Milestone underscores execution of pivotal Phase 2/3 trial evaluating Annamycin in combination with cytarabine for relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) Fully treated, randomized, double-blind n=90 Part A population sets up Annamycin dose selection for Part B, with balanced representation of AML patients who failed 7+3 chemotherapy and venetoclax-based regimens HOUSTON, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Moleculin Biotech, Inc. (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”) today announced that dosing has been completed in Part A of its pivotal Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial evaluating Annamycin in combination with cytarabine (AnnAraC) for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML). The Company remains on track to report comprehensive Part A data in the first quarter of 2027. Reaching this treatment milestone represents continued execution in the MIRACLE trial as the Company advances toward a comprehensive analysis of the full 90-patient Part A population. The planned Q1 2027 data readout is expected to provide important insights into the potential of AnnAraC across clinically distinct R/R AML patient populations and support selection of the optimal Annamycin dose for advancement into Part B of the trial. articles.summary: HOUSTON, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Moleculin Biotech, Inc., (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”), today announced that it filed an amendment to its amended and restated certificate of incorporation with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware to effect a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its common stock. The reverse stock split will take effect at 12:01 am (Eastern Time) on October 20, 2026, and the Company’s common stock will open for trading on The Nasdaq Capital Market on October 20, 2026 on a post-split basis, under the existing ticker symbol “MBRX” but with a new CUSIP number 60855D 507. As a result of the reverse stock split, every 20 shares of the Company’s common stock issued and outstanding prior to the opening of trading on October 20, 2026 will be consolidated into one issued and outstanding share, with no change in the nominal par value per share of $0.001.
